purpose: Create a durable first-class Song Reference evidence contract with explicit source provenance, exact Song and optional Version binding, section locator, comparison dimensions, loudness-match policy, notes and artist decision history without turning a reference into a target or action authority.

lineage.outcome: The artist can retain named Song references as durable evidence with explicit comparison purpose and source provenance, then keep notes and decisions bound to the exact reference revision that informed them.
lineage.capability: First-class Song Reference evidence and immutable comparison-decision history

implementation_contract.reference_truth: A Song Reference is evidence for comparison, not a target, quality score, genre-average commandment, mastering instruction or automatic artistic decision.
implementation_contract.provenance: Reference source provenance records how source identity was established. USER_DECLARED, OBSERVED and PROVIDER_VERIFIED remain distinct, and observed/provider evidence requires an explicit source_ref. Provenance does not verify copyright, rights or license status.
implementation_contract.binding: Every reference is Song-scoped. Optional Version binding must resolve to the same canonical Song. Section locator remains an explicit locator and is not promoted into a fully verified canonical section object by this increment.
implementation_contract.comparison_policy: Comparison dimensions and loudness-match policy are metadata only. This increment performs no playback, LUFS/RMS measurement, normalization, gain change or audio processing.
implementation_contract.decision_history: Artist notes and decisions are append-only USER_DECLARED creative evidence bound to the exact immutable reference claim current when the event was recorded. Revising a reference cannot rewrite earlier judgment context.
implementation_contract.mutation: The only durable mutation is bounded evidence recording in canonical EvidenceMemory. No DAW, provider, audio file, Song Version, publication, spend or external system is changed and no action authority is granted.

completion_proof: reference definitions persist through canonical EvidenceMemory and survive LineageStore reopen
reference identity is bound to one exact Song and cross-Song Version binding fails closed
optional exact Version and explicit section locator are retained without inventing a section object
source provenance remains explicit and provider/observed source identity cannot exist without a source_ref
comparison dimensions are canonicalized and loudness-match policy remains metadata rather than audio processing
reference revisions use immutable evidence supersession while old revision claims remain retrievable
artist notes and decisions remain append-only and bind the exact reference revision that informed them
malformed or conflicting active reference evidence fails closed rather than selecting an arbitrary truth
public reference shape contains no target, rating, rights-verification, loudness-processing or execution-authority fields
